summary: Fomento Económico Mexicano, S.A.B. de C.V. (FEMSA) filed a Form 6-K for May 2026, attaching a Code of Principles and Best Corporate Governance Practices Questionnaire regarding shareholder meetings and sustainability. The submission is a routine corporate governance report, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or material corporate action is described. The filing is a periodic disclosure with no deal terms, prices, premiums, or board recommendations. As a foreign private issuer report, it corresponds to a US-equivalent current report on Form 8-K for governance matters, but no event triggers special-situations classification.
